description: Services industriels de Lausanne publishes a map of recommended heating sources for buildings under the city's territorial energy plan. The recommendations support its renewable-heat strategy towards 2050. They prioritise district-heating connections where eligible and feasible, with local individual renewable sources elsewhere. The building classifications combine several inputs, including Vaud consumption estimates. Coverage is Lausanne; the metadata give a source-data update of 4 June 2026 and a CH1903+ coordinate system. Access is through a linked online map. No downloadable file format, reuse licence or charge is established by the inspected page. The algorithmic recommendations do not replace a professional building-specific assessment. A mapped connection may prove infeasible, and dates for opportunity-dependent network extensions are indicative. The resource supplies proposed heating choices and connection constraints for building-stock scenarios and capacity planning. The related Lausanne underground cadastre describes existing utilities, while the Vaud heat-supply scenario has canton-wide scope. Viageo's public demo label leaves production availability unresolved.
